native_runtime.platform: native Linux independent prefix only; WSL and repository .venv are not accepted
native_runtime.prefix: explicit caller argument; no default prefix or reused historical ABI receipt
native_runtime.fresh_abi_receipt: generated into the new run directory by scripts/task40_fresh_c1/qualify_imports_only.py before launch
native_runtime.live_validation: runner compares executable, sys.prefix, Python 3.12, all imported module paths, loaded numerical library paths, MPICH library/version/size, PETSc 3.25.6 complex128/int32, DOLFINx/Basix 0.10.0, MPC 0.10.5 and one-thread environment against the local receipt
native_runtime.slepc: not imported by this W0 runner and not an admission dependency

entrypoint.total_deadline_utc_source: The caller passes the deadline from the single persisted W0 window record; this wrapper never computes now-plus-duration or rolls the deadline on retry.
entrypoint.total_deadline_utc_cli_format: %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ (UTC, whole seconds), passed unchanged through the user service to --total-deadline-utc
entrypoint.fractional_window_deadline_handling: Floor the exact frozen deadline once before CLI entry and preserve the original T0/deadline plus the lost fractional second in the runtime window record; never round up.
entrypoint.frozen_total_utc_deadline: caller-supplied TOTAL_DEADLINE_UTC from the current persisted W0 window record; no run-specific date is embedded in this dependency manifest
entrypoint.admission_authority: MemAvailable plus effective cgroup limits/current use, sampled process-tree RSS, declared additional allocations and evidence reserve; the worker cap remains the stricter 3 GiB
entrypoint.no_fe_control_smoke: Set TASK40_W0_NO_FE_CONTROL_SMOKE=1 to use the same fresh-ABI, admission, user-service, worker/checker subreaper, fixed-deadline, swap, PID and descendant-cleanup gates with explicit non-numerical worker/checker sentinels. A pass is CONTROL_SMOKE_PASS_NO_FE and is not a PDE result.

same_live_before_component.receipt_numeric_checker: src.solvers.fresh_c1_live_contract.validate_live_receipt; checker reopens and checks all 4 primary/8 independent Gauss records, canonical context, 532 modes and metrics, 5 recovery states, 5 output-mode ledgers, global action/RHS defects, kernel provenance and unchanged carrier

required_targeted_native_test_command: After the local qualified-activation pure tests pass, run the no-FE user-service control smoke on the native workstation with TASK40_W0_NO_FE_CONTROL_SMOKE=1 bash scripts/run_fresh_c1_p6_native.sh "$T40_NATIVE_PREFIX" "$T40_CONTROL_SMOKE_RUN_DIR" "$T40_FIXED_DEADLINE_UTC"; inspect CONTROL_SMOKE_PASS_NO_FE, both supervised phase summaries, nonempty/distinct worker and checker PIDs, descendants_cleared=true and remaining_child_pids=[]. Then immediately run the same command in a new run directory with TASK40_W0_NO_FE_CONTROL_SMOKE unset and the exact same TOTAL_DEADLINE_UTC. Do not recompute the deadline.

local_wsl2_authorized_runtime.authorization: explicit opt-in local WSL2 execution profile; native_linux remains the default
local_wsl2_authorized_runtime.platform: local WSL2 kernel only; rejects native Linux, WSL1, and other hosts
local_wsl2_authorized_runtime.host_binding: fresh imports-only receipt binds runtime profile, WSL2 kernel release, execution platform, and exact local boot ID; execution must match the same host and boot
local_wsl2_authorized_runtime.prefix: independent run-qualified prefix under the local Task40 artifact directory; repository .venv is not accepted
local_wsl2_authorized_runtime.abi: same frozen ABI as native_runtime: Python 3.12, MPICH MPI1, PETSc 3.25.6 complex128/int32, DOLFINx/Basix 0.10.0, dolfinx_mpc 0.10.5, one thread

required_targeted_local_wsl2_test_comman: After local WSL2 qualified-activation pure tests pass, run the no-FE control smoke with TASK40_W0_NO_FE_CONTROL_SMOKE=1 bash scripts/run_fresh_c1_p6_local_wsl.sh "$T40_LOCAL_PREFIX" "$T40_CONTROL_SMOKE_RUN_DIR" "$T40_FIXED_DEADLINE_UTC"; inspect CONTROL_SMOKE_PASS_NO_FE, both supervised phase summaries, nonempty/distinct worker and checker PIDs, descendants_cleared=true and remaining_child_pids=[]. Then immediately run the same local WSL2 command in a new run directory with TASK40_W0_NO_FE_CONTROL_SMOKE unset and the exact same TOTAL_DEADLINE_UTC. Do not recompute the deadline; record the explicit local WSL2 profile and same-boot receipt.
